entities.name: Rica
entities.description: A composed, stoic human avenger pilot from Kroog who survived the Fall of Kroog.

entities.name: Llora
entities.description: Instructor of the cadet pilots, incinerated at the barricade.

entities.name: Sanwell
entities.description: Fellow pilot who fled with Rica.

entities.name: Carlo
entities.description: Panicked fellow pilot killed by Fallaji soldiers.

entities.name: Mishra

entities.name: Traxos

entities.name: Kroog

entities.name: Fall of Kroog

events.summary: As Mishra's forces invade, cadets including Rica are promoted to pilots of sword-pattern avengers.
events.quote: The cadets, including Rica, were urgently promoted to full pilots

events.summary: Traxos arrives; Llora orders the pilots to flank it, but defenses crumble and Llora and the barricade soldiers are incinerated.
events.quote: Llora and the soldiers at the barricade were incinerated

events.summary: Carlo is killed by Fallaji soldiers; Sanwell and Rica flee the city.
events.quote: Carlo was killed by Fallaji soldiers
